purpose: The composer of a generative AI chat (Cloudscape prompt input, AI Elements PromptInput): a text area that grows with the prompt up to `maxRows`, a Submit control that becomes Stop while a response is being generated, a toolbar row for secondary controls (attach, mode), an attachments row above the text, an optional character limit with a counter, and constraint text under it (a disclaimer or the shortcuts it accepts). Enter submits; Shift+Enter adds a line; an IME composition never submits. It is controlled: the owner holds the text, receives `submit` with the trimmed prompt, and clears it. While `state` is `submitted` or `streaming` the reader can keep typing the next prompt, but cannot submit it until the response ends or they press Stop.
useWhen: The input of any conversation with the generative AI assistant.
A single "Ask about this page" box that opens a conversation.
avoidWhen: A text field in a form → `textarea` inside `field`.
Search over a list → `input` with a search icon or `property-filter`.
related: textarea` — the form control; this one has no visible label and submits on Enter.
conversation` — the log above it; only the log scrolls.
suggestion-group` — prompts the reader can send without typing.
file-dropzone`, `chip` — what attachment flows compose into the `attachments` slot.
bestPractices: Placeholder is a suggested question with no end punctuation (`Ask a question`); never the only instruction.
Put the disclaimer and the shortcuts in `hint`, not in the placeholder.
Set `state` from the request so Submit turns into Stop; wire `stop` to abort it.
Clear `v-model` in the `submit` handler and keep focus in the input.
Use `maxLength` only when the backend has a limit; the counter is the warning.
